home.title: Home
home.description: Loveworld Economic Advancement Program (LEAP): equipping Loveworld Nation members in Canada to build careers, businesses and generational wealth.

summary.title: The Concept
summary.text: A comprehensive and strategic blueprint for an economic advancement program tailored to Loveworld Nation members in Canada.

summary.title: The Vision
summary.text: A thriving community of economically empowered believers in Canada who build generational wealth and serve as financial pillars for the Gospel.

summary.title: The Mission
summary.text: Equipping members with spiritual wisdom, practical skills and strategic networks to grow careers, launch businesses and reach financial independence.

about.title: About LEAP
about.description: The concept, vision and mission behind the Loveworld Economic Advancement Program in Canada.
about.heading: About LEAP
about.lead: Where Loveworld Nation’s spiritual principles of flourishing and dominion meet practical economic strategy for Canada.

blueprint.title: The Blueprint
blueprint.description: Four strategic pillars: career acceleration, kingdom entrepreneurship, financial stewardship and a spiritual foundation for prosperity.
blueprint.heading: The Blueprint: Four Strategic Pillars
blueprint.lead: Structured support for members who are looking to advance, built on the expertise already within the congregation.

pillars.title: Career Acceleration & Professional Integration
pillars.intro: Designed to help professionals, including new immigrants and recent graduates, navigate the Canadian job market and secure high-value employment.

items.title: Canadian Market Readiness
items.text: Workshops on ATS-friendly resume writing, Canadian interview culture, and optimizing appropriate social media, like LinkedIn profiles, for the local industry sectors.

items.title: Industry Mentorship Program
items.text: Pairing emerging professionals with established Christ Embassy members holding senior roles to provide industry-specific guidance and sponsorship.

items.title: Skill Upgrading Initiatives
items.text: Partnering with local institutions or offering subsidized certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile, Data Analytics) to make members highly competitive.

pillars.title: Kingdom Entrepreneurship & Innovation
pillars.intro: Designed to incubate new businesses and scale existing member-owned enterprises.

items.title: The Business Incubator
items.text: A 12-week accelerator for aspiring entrepreneurs, teaching them how to register a business in Ontario, write business plans, and market to the diverse Canadian demographic.

items.title: Access to Capital & Grants
items.text: Training sessions on how to secure provincial and federal small business grants, loans, and startup funding.

items.title: B2B Networking & Kingdom Commerce
items.text: Establishing an internal business directory and hosting quarterly “Marketplace Mixers” to encourage members to do business with one another and keep wealth circulating within the church community.

pillars.title: Financial Stewardship & Wealth Creation
pillars.intro: Designed to transition members from financial survival to sustainable wealth building.

items.title: Canadian Financial Literacy
items.text: Masterclasses on maximizing Canadian investment vehicles (TFSAs, RRSPs, FHSAs) and effective tax planning.

items.title: Real Estate & Asset Acquisition
items.text: Seminars led by trusted realtors and mortgage brokers on navigating the GTA real estate market, first-time homebuyer strategies, and property investment.

items.title: Debt Eradication Clinics
items.text: Confidential, structured support groups and financial counseling to help members aggressively eliminate consumer debt.

pillars.title: Spiritual Foundation for Prosperity
pillars.intro: Designed to align all economic activities with the core teachings of Loveworld Nation.

items.title: Mindset Transformation
items.text: Specialized teaching series on overcoming poverty mentalities, understanding the kingdom of wealth, and reigning in life.

items.title: Purpose-Driven Wealth
items.text: Cultivating a strong culture of partnership, emphasizing that economic advancement is ultimately for the financing of the Gospel and Kingdom expansion.
